column_semantics: The schedule has a Reference Rate and Spread column and a separate Interest Rate column. When PIK is present, the Reference Rate and Spread cell identifies the PIK portion of the quoted spread, and the Interest Rate column shows the current all-in coupon based on the reference rate plus that full spread. The schedule does not print a separate cash-leg rate column.

rationale: The printed schedule's Reference Rate and Spread column quotes the full spread and identifies the PIK portion in that same cell, e.g. SOFR + 7.25 % (4.25 % PIK), while the Interest Rate column prints 10.95 %, the current coupon for SOFR plus the full 7.25 % spread. LCM SDC rows similarly print SOFR + 13.25 % PIK beside a 17.02 % Interest Rate and SOFR + 10.00 % PIK beside a 13.77 % Interest Rate, indicating the stated Interest Rate includes the PIK spread rather than excluding it. No separate cash-leg rate column is printed.
